# Season 16: New logic and a battle pass for the game board

![Season 16: New logic and a battle pass for the game board](/uploads/311_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In the coming season 16, the game board will no longer be used in its current form. Season 16 will go live on March 26, 2024 with the update “Atlantic City - America's Playground” (Patch 50) and will bring fundamental changes.

## This is how the new season will work

Instead of the old game board, there will be a new logic to get the rewards.

The usual **Challenges** will remain. By completing the challenges you will receive **SCORE points**. These SCORE points in turn increase your score rank. **You will then receive **25 tickets** per rank. These tickets are a new currency that you can use to choose rewards for the season. This means you can only choose the rewards you want.

The tickets are only **valid** in the respective season.

![Season Tickets](/uploads/fo76-pts-seasonpass-coffee888-2024-02-19-02-rank.jpg) 

The rewards are divided into **10 pages**. 10 rewards per side. Depending on your rank in the season, you will receive access to additional pages. *You will probably get access to the 2nd page from rank 10, to the 3rd from rank 20, etc.*

The rewards listed cost more or less tickets. You can choose there which ones you want sooner or later.

![Season example page](/uploads/season-battlepass-upbeat-fallout76-2-15-2024-4-28-00-pm.jpg) 

## Fallout 1st Rewards: Battle Pass

Fallout 1st rewards have only been available to Fallout 1st subscribers in previous game boards. This is now changing. Of course, the rewards are still available to Fallout 1st subscribers. It is also possible to purchase a **Battlepass** and gain access to these rewards.

![Season Battle Pass Definition](/uploads/season16-battle-pass.jpg)

## You can still buy ranks

With the new system you can also buy ranks, just like you can now on the game board.

![Buy Season Ranks](/uploads/season-battlepass-upbeat-fallout76-2-15-2024-4-28-48-pm.jpg) 

## Official description of next season on the PTS

As of: February 26, 2024

Each new Season offers a collection of themed rewards that are available to be claimed only for the duration of the Season. Complete in-game activities to earn S.C.O.R.E. and Rank Up. Each Rank earned grants you Tickets that you can redeem to claim Season Rewards.

Complete Challenges to earn S.C.O.R.E.

Earn S.C.O.R.E. by completing challenges. Challenges are given daily and weekly and require completing a variety of in-game activities such as killing certain types of creatures or finding and collecting items in the world.

Ranking Up

When you accumulate enough S.C.O.R.E. you will rank up. Each new Rank you earn grants you 25 Tickets.

It is also possible to purchase Ranks for 150 Atoms per Rank up to Rank 100.

You can continue to earn S.C.O.R.E. and Rank Up beyond Rank 100.

Redeem Tickets to claim Season Rewards

 The Tickets you earn from ranking up can be redeemed for rewards on the Seasons screen.

Access the Seasons screen from the Main Menu or from within game by pressing [Map] to open your Map, then [LShoulder] to open the Main Menu and selecting "Seasons".

Seasons Rewards are listed across multiple pages with each page containing several rewards. Access to the first page of rewards is automatic. A Access additional pages by Ranking Up to the required Season Rank.

You can claim any available rewards by redeeming the required number of Tickets. The Tickets required for each Season Reward vary, with smaller rewards typically requiring fewer Tickets than larger rewards. Occasionally rewards may require 0 Tickets and are free to claim as soon as the page is unlocked.
